$comment: Fault-injection scenarios for tests/fault-injection/fault-proxy.mjs. IDs map to docs/resilience/fault-injection-testplan.md. Rule fields: path (substring or /regex/), method, skipFirst (leave the first N matching requests alone), onlyOnce, delayMs, blackhole, cut ('before'|'after'), respond {status, headers, body}, mutate ('pagingLoop'|'emptyObject'|'html'|'nullFields'|'truncate').

passthrough.description: No fault. Baseline run - record what a healthy bootstrap looks like before injecting anything.

throttle-retry-after.description: 429 with Retry-After: 5 on the second membership page. Checks whether the header is honoured and the paging loop resumes.

throttle-bare.description: 429 without Retry-After on every planning read. Checks for exponential backoff with jitter versus a retry storm versus giving up.

blackhole.description: Request is accepted and never answered. Checks for a client-side timeout; without one the tab stays in 'loading' forever.

cut-connection.description: Socket is destroyed after the request was received - the TCP equivalent of a dropped load balancer.

cut-after-request.description: POST reaches the API, the answer never does. Verifies that repeating the write is safe (client-generated id + server-side upsert).

paging-loop.description: Every page answers with the same nextPageToken. Checks for a page cap or repeated-token detection in listAllPages().

fail-settings.description: 500 on /settings only. Everything else is healthy - the plan is not empty, one call failed.

fail-absences.description: 500 on /absences only. Checks whether the six successful parallel loads survive one failure (Promise.all versus allSettled).

garbage-body.description: 200 OK with a body that is not the contract: empty object, then an HTML error page.

null-fields.description: Contract-shaped response whose item fields are null - the shape survives, the values do not.

truncated-body.description: Response ends mid-JSON. Checks the parse-failure path rather than the status-code path.

expire-token.description: Every call answers 401 from a point in time onwards - the token went stale mid-session. Checks for exactly one refresh, not a 5-minute wall of 401s.

forbidden.description: 403 on every planning read - consent revoked or the identity is refused.

slow-graph-team.description: 60 s delay on membership reads. Against the API this shows the client side; run L3 to see the server-side global semaphore.

health-lies.description: Everything fails except /health, which keeps answering 200. Mirrors what a real database outage looks like today.
